title: Decode String
statement: Decode an encoded string. `k[encoded]` means the encoded substring inside the brackets is repeated k times. Inputs are valid and nesting is allowed. Digits are not zero and do not have leading zeros.
hints: When you see '[', you must remember both the current string and the repeat count that applies to the upcoming substring.
A stack of (previous_string, repeat) pairs handles nesting.
On ']', pop, repeat the current buffer, and append it to the previous string.

approaches.name: Recursion with an index
approaches.explanation: A helper consumes one substring and returns the new index.

approaches.name: Explicit stack
approaches.explanation: Same state as the call stack, stored manually.

editorial: Maintain the string built at the current nesting level and the number currently being parsed. An opening bracket pushes both and resets them. A closing bracket pops and concatenates previous + current * repeat. Digits extend the number, and letters extend the current string.
